name: euro-creator
description: Build ETS2/ATS paint job mods from a Blender truck and a painted texture

scripts.build: npm run build -w @euro-creator/core && npm run build -w @euro-creator/server && npm run build -w @euro-creator/web
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @euro-creator/server" "npm run dev -w @euro-creator/web"
